messages:
Eli: FYI forwarding Aurora Insurance request — they want to onboard a custom claims triage model. Main asks: PHI-safe, HIPAA compliance, model evals + latency <250ms for 512 tokens.

Eli: Customer pasted their ask: "model trained on internal claims notes, must redact PHI, run in our VPC, and pass safety/regression evals before go-live"

Tara SE: thanks. do we have a recommended onboarding checklist for PHI models? worried about dataset handling and log redaction. :lock:

Aditya ML: short answer: use Redwood Private + KMS, disable request/response logging, enable prefix KV caching off for private sensitive payloads. need dataset inventory + schema.

Sophia Sec: +1 on inventory. also request a DPIA and data flow diagram. we'll need to run PII detectors on sample outputs and confirm no PHI leakage in generations. I can draft an acceptance checklist.

Tara SE: could we propose an eval matrix for them? basic items: hallucination rate on named entities, PHI redaction recall/precision, latency p95, and regen-failures.

Aditya ML: here's a minimal eval snippet we can ask them to run and share results for verification:
```json
{
  "evals": [
    {"name":"pii-redaction","dataset":"claims_sample_500","metric":"redaction_recall"},
    {"name":"entity-hallucination","dataset":"gold_labels_500","metric":"entity_precision"}
  ]
}
```

Eli: Great. Action items: 1) Tara — send onboarding checklist + request sample dataset (anonymized) 2) Aditya — draft eval config + thresholds 3) Sophia — draft security acceptance + DPIA template. I'll ping account once we have timeframe.

Tara SE: I'll loop in enablement for a short 30-min runbook session during onboarding. prefer wk of Apr 4 for a kickoff.

Sophia Sec: Also flagging renewal risk note — if we don't resolve PHI requirements they'll likely go private deployment elsewhere. mark as high-touch. :warning:

deploy-bot: Incident coverage reminder: schedule security review channel #sec-review within 3 business days for expedited customers.

Eli: Noted. I'll update the CS ticket and create a brief summary doc in Drive + link, and post back here when done. :+1:
